capability.reducedMotion: static topology and authored focus indication

controls.label: Table spread
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Scales slot offsets from stage centre without changing source frame size or crop.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes occupied table rectangle and perimeter negative space.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.5, source-3 centre moves at least 5% of stage width between 0.52 and 0.92 while its media checksum remains unchanged.

controls.label: Overlap
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Moves neighbouring stable slots toward or away from their shared midpoint under deterministic collision bounds.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes physical contact between frames; never changes z-order or source visibility floor.
controls.causalTest: Ordinary-six total pair intersection increases monotonically and no frame loses more than 22% projected area.

controls.label: Under-light
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Scales only frame-exterior light geometry; source state is invariant.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes halo opacity behind frames and table luminance within measured bounds.
controls.causalTest: Source canvas hashes are identical at 0.00 and 0.70; outside-frame luminance differs.

controls.label: Focus
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Selects ordered automatic route, final-only loupe, or no automatic focus.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes frame lift, outline, and under-light emphasis only.
controls.causalTest: At review midpoint, route has one focus index, loupe-only has none before finale, and none never raises a frame.

controls.label: Nudge restraint
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Scales seam-safe periodic translation and rotation around stable slots.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes handling breath without changing topology, overlap ceiling, or media treatment.
controls.causalTest: At canonical t=0.375, at least one frame offset changes; t=0 and t=1 remain identical.
